defs.def: made of concrete 混凝土制的

ex.s: It is made with local materials, has a flat roof, wood paneling, concrete floors and custom-made furniture.
ex.t: 它使用当地材料建造，有平屋顶、木镶板、混凝土地面和定制家具。

ex.s: A non-Newtonian fluid is strange because you can pour pour it like a liquid, but if you put any pressure on it, it suddenly becomes hard as concrete concrete.
ex.t: 非牛顿流体很奇怪，因为你可以像液体一样倾倒，但如果你对它施加任何压力，它突然变得像混凝土一样坚硬。

ex.s: Lacking any concrete evidence, some even claim it was supernatural powers!
ex.t: 由于缺乏任何确凿的证据，有些人甚至声称这是超自然力量！

defs.def: based on facts, not on ideas or guesses 确实的，具体的（而非想像或猜测的）

ex.s: “We usually think in very concrete terms when doing something on a screen,” said Simone Schnall, senior author of the study.
ex.t: “我们在屏幕上做事情时，通常用非常具体的方式思考，”该研究的主要作者Simone Schnall说。

ex.s: Most of my reading through primary， middle and high school was factual reading． I read for knowledge， and to make A's on my tests． Occasionally， I would read a novel that was assigned， but I didn't enjoy this type of reading． I liked facts， things that are concrete． I thought anything abstract left too much room for argument．
ex.t: 在小学、初中和高中阶段，我的大部分阅读都是事实性阅读。我为获取知识而读，为了在考试中拿A。偶尔，我也会读老师指定的小说，但我并不喜欢这种阅读。我喜欢事实，喜欢具体的东西。我认为任何抽象的事物都留下了太多争论的空间。

ex.s: Then, making concrete plans for improvement will bring you a step closer to better self-management.
ex.t: 然后，制定具体的改进计划将使您更接近更好的自我管理。

ex.s: You can include in your mind map: • metaphors and similes • concrete nouns and vivid verbs • words that rhyme • your feelings • a personal story • anything the theme makes you think of Then write your poems based on your mind maps.
ex.t: 您可以在思维导图中包含以下内容： •隐喻和比喻•具体名词和生动的动词•押韵的词语•您的感受•个人故事•主题让你想到的任何事情，然后根据你的思维导图写诗。
